value.rationale: The primary statistical model was introduced for flexible underdispersion and numerical estimation. A complete 3-factorial-cumulant image and invertibility criterion determines whether a natural moment fit exists, while a sharp third-order inequality excludes all at-least-two-trial binomials even when mean and variance can match. This is a motivated complete identifiability classification and structural model limitation, not a reparameterization or an arbitrary numerical example.
